description: This file defines a server package for integrating GitHub with an MCP (Model Control Protocol) system. It includes functions for creating servers, handling completions, and managing request parameters, with extensive support for pagination and parameter validation.

methods.name: NewServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MCP server instance with specified version and options.

methods.name: CompletionsHandler
methods.description: Returns a handler function for processing completion requests, supporting resource and prompt references.

methods.name: OptionalParamOK
methods.description: Fetches a parameter of any type from request args, indicating presence and handling type errors.

methods.name: isAcceptedError
methods.description: Checks if an error is an accepted github.AcceptedError.

methods.name: RequiredParam
methods.description: Fetches a required parameter of a specific type from request args, with validation.

methods.name: RequiredInt
methods.description: Fetches a required integer parameter from request args.

methods.name: RequiredBigInt
methods.description: Fetches a required int64 parameter, validating safe conversion from float64.

methods.name: OptionalParam
methods.description: Fetches an optional parameter of any type from request args.

methods.name: OptionalIntParam
methods.description: Fetches an optional float64 parameter and converts it to int.

methods.name: OptionalIntParamWithDefault
methods.description: Fetches an int parameter with a default fallback.

methods.name: OptionalBoolParamWithDefault
methods.description: Fetches a bool parameter with a default fallback.

methods.name: OptionalStringArrayParam
methods.description: Fetches a string array parameter, coercing from various possible types.

methods.name: convertStringSliceToBigIntSlice
methods.description: Converts a slice of strings to a slice of int64s.

methods.name: convertStringToBigInt
methods.description: Converts a string to int64 with error handling.

methods.name: OptionalBigIntArrayParam
methods.description: Fetches an array of big integers from request args, converting from strings.

methods.name: WithPagination
methods.description: Adds pagination properties to a JSON schema.

methods.name: WithUnifiedPagination
methods.description: Adds unified pagination properties to a JSON schema, including cursor support.

methods.name: WithCursorPagination
methods.description: Adds cursor-based pagination properties to a JSON schema.

methods.name: OptionalPaginationParams
methods.description: Extracts pagination parameters with defaults from request args.

methods.name: OptionalCursorPaginationParams
methods.description: Extracts cursor pagination parameters from request args.

methods.name: ToGraphQLParams
methods.description: Converts cursor pagination parameters to GraphQL-specific pagination parameters.

methods.name: MarshalledTextResult
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON and wraps it in an MCP call result.
